summary.text: John Steinbeck is a Republican member of the Nevada Senate, representing District 18 in Clark County. He was first elected in November 2024, and the legislature lists him as Fire Chief of the Clark County Fire Department.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Steinbeck was born in Santa Monica, California, in 1971 and attended Western High School in Las Vegas.

His page lists an associate's degree in fire science from the College of Southern Nevada, a bachelor of science in emergency management from Purdue Global, and the Naval Postgraduate School Executive Leadership Program in 2018.

The page lists 34 years with the Clark County Fire Department, where he has been fire chief since 2020, and says he responded to Hurricane Katrina in 2005 and to New York City after September 11, 2001.
He sits on the Senate Jobs and Economy Committee.
